title: Deterministic parity harness for v2->v3 attention kernel swap under mixed-precision and interleaved prefill
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a deterministic, reproducible test harness that validates numerical and control-flow parity when swapping attention kernels (FlashAttention v2 -> v3) during live serving. The harness must cover: mixed-precision paths (fp16, bf16, int8-ish quantization shims), token-interleaved prefill + decode sequences, KV cache warm/cold transitions, and edge-case sequence shapes (odd lengths, long context truncation). Goal is to detect subtle regressions that affect downstream outputs and to provide per-test diff artifacts for root-cause triage.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness that can run deterministically on CI/GPU workers with seeded RNGs and pinned CUDA/cuDNN versions
Coverage matrix: kernel (v2,v3), precision (fp32,fp16,bf16), prefill mode (single-stream, interleaved multi-stream), KV-cache state (cold,warm), and sequence length variations
Per-run artifact: token-level diffs, numerical error stats (L1/L2/max), stack traces for mismatches, and a compact regression fingerprint stored in S3 for comparisons
Automated CI job that fails on non-trivial semantic drift (e.g., >1e-3 L2 per-token or divergent token selection affecting top-5), with a clear rerun workflow
A short triage playbook documenting common root causes and first-line checks (kernel flags, workspace layout differences, quantization scale mismatch, padding/stride handling)
implementation_steps: Design harness API that can replay a logged request stream and toggle kernel backend per-layer
Add deterministic RNG seeding and environment pinning (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, NCCL settings, OMP_NUM_THREADS) in test runner
Instrument runtime to capture fine-grained telemetry: per-layer outputs, KV cache snapshots, kernel selection decisions and all kernel args
Create matrix generator for mixed-precision and interleaved prefill scenarios; generate ~200 canonical testcases covering edge shapes
Implement artifact uploader and comparator that computes per-token diffs and aggregates metrics into an S3 bundle
Wire harness to CI (circleci/github actions) and add a gating rule for the runtime-1.20 branch
Run baseline against last-known-good kernels and capture fingerprints for future regression detection
notes: We intentionally avoid relying on floating-point equality; use tolerances and semantic checks (top-k changes) to prioritize user-impacting regressions
Interleaved prefill means mixing short and long contexts on the same device; this surfaced a workspace overlap issue in prior investigations
Prior tickets found issues around tail-padding and stride when switching to v3; this harness should include explicit padded/unpadded variants
Quantization shims here are shallow emulation (scale/zero-point) to surface algorithmic drift; don't integrate full quant runtime yet
